import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex

/-!
# Cocycles representing the Mayer--Vietoris connecting map

The connecting class is computed by lifting an overlap cocycle to a pair of
cochains and gluing their differentials. The class is the actual connecting
morphism of the short exact sequence, with the sign fixed by the difference
of the first restriction and the second restriction.

This is the representative calculation for the cup-compatible circle-product
step in Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, integral cohomology.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Integral simplicial cocycles are the kernel of the cochain differential. -/
def simplicialCocycles (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℤ (IntegralSimplicialCochain K n) :=
  LinearMap.ker (simplicialCochainDifferential K n)

/-- The concrete cocycle kernel maps to the categorical cycle object. -/
def simplicialCocycleToCycles (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ (simplicialCocycles K n) ⟶
      (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).cycles n :=
  (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).liftCycles
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCocycles K n).subtype) (n + 1)
    ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' rfl) (by
      simp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex, CochainComplex.of_d]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact φ.2)

/-- The cohomology class of an integral simplicial cocycle. -/
def simplicialCohomologyClass (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCocycles K n →ₗ[ℤ] IntegralSimplicialCohomology K n :=
  (simplicialCocycleToCycles K n ≫
    (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).homologyπ n).hom

private def cochainElement {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] (x : M) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ M :=
  ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ M x)

private theorem cochainElement_comp {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ N] (x : M) (f : ModuleCat.of ℤ M ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ N) :
    cochainElement x ≫ f = cochainElement (f x) := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  simp [cochainElement]

private theorem cochainElement_zero {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] :
    cochainElement (0 : M) = 0 := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  simp [cochainElement]

private theorem cochainElement_injective {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] :
    Function.Injective (cochainElement (M := M)) := by
  intro x y h
  have he := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h (1 : ℤ)
  change LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ M x 1 = LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ M y 1 at he
  simpa only [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one] using he

private theorem simplicialCohomologyClass_eq_lift (K : SSet) (n : ℕ)
    (φ : simplicialCocycles K n) :
    cochainElement (simplicialCohomologyClass K n φ) =
      (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).liftCycles (cochainElement φ.1) (n + 1)
        ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' rfl) (by
          simp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex, CochainComplex.of_d]
          rw [cochainElement_comp]
          change cochainElement (simplicialCochainDifferential K n φ.1) = 0
          rw [φ.2, cochainElement_zero]) ≫
        (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).homologyπ n := by
  rw [show cochainElement (simplicialCohomologyClass K n φ) =
      cochainElement φ ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCohomologyClass K n) from
    (cochainElement_comp φ _).symm]
  change cochainElement φ ≫ (simplicialCocycleToCycles K n ≫ _) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  apply (cancel_mono ((integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).iCycles n)).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, simplicialCocycleToCycles, liftCycles_i]
  exact cochainElement_comp φ _

/-- A lift of an overlap cocycle and a gluing of its differential compute the
actual Mayer--Vietoris connecting class. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ)
    (γ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n)
    (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain A n) (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain B n)
    (θ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1))
    (hγ : simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n (α, β) = γ.1)
    (hθ : simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B (n + 1) θ.1 =
      (simplicialCochainDifferential A n α, simplicialCochainDifferential B n β)) :
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B n
      (simplicialCohomologyClass _ n γ) =
        simplicialCohomologyClass _ (n + 1) θ := by
  have h := (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).δ_eq
    n (n + 1) (by simp) (cochainElement γ.1) (by
      simp only [simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex,
        integralSimplicialCochainComplex, CochainComplex.of_d]
      rw [cochainElement_comp]
      change cochainElement (simplicialCochainDifferential _ n γ.1) = 0
      rw [γ.2, cochainElement_zero])
    (cochainElement (α, β)) (by
      simp only [simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex,
        integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_f]
      erw [cochainElement_comp]
      exact congrArg cochainElement hγ)
    (cochainElement θ.1) (by
      simp only [simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex,
        integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_f,
        integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex, CochainComplex.of_d]
      erw [cochainElement_comp, cochainElement_comp]
      exact congrArg cochainElement hθ)
    (n + 2) ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' rfl)
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← simplicialCohomologyClass_eq_lift,
    ← simplicialCohomologyClass_eq_lift, cochainElement_comp] at h
  exact @cochainElement_injective (IntegralSimplicialCohomology (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex)
    (n + 1)) _ _ _ _ h

end Mumford.Analytic
